description: Source code for 'iossim', an executable that runs an app in the iOS Simulator, managing simulator sessions, app launching, and output handling.

classes.name: SimulatorDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class handling simulator session events, output redirection, and error logging.

methods.name: tailOutput
methods.description: Copies simulated app's stdout to the executable's stdout while the app is running.

methods.name: localizedSimulatorErrorString:
methods.description: Fetches a localized error string from the Simulator bundle.

methods.name: session:didStart:withError:
methods.description: Handles the start of a simulator session, manages output thread, and error conditions.

methods.name: session:didEndWithError:
methods.description: Handles the end of a simulator session, checks for crashes, and logs system messages.

methods.name: initWithStdioPath:developerDir:
methods.description: Initializes the delegate with paths for app output and developer directory.
